title: AsItIs config (.asitisrc.json)
description: Config for the asitis linter and the lint_steering tool. Rule ids are listed at https://asitis.app/rules. asitis itself checks rule ids against the rules of the installed version.

extends.description: recommended (the default) or strict: notes become warnings and the skills and config scans run, so the sec-* rules in them are on.

ignore.description: Files not linted. Globs relative to the project folder: ** any folders, * and ? inside one name. A pattern without a slash matches at any depth; a pattern that matches a folder matches everything in it.

overrides.description: Rule settings for some files. Later entries win over earlier ones and over rules.

include.description: Opt-in scans beyond markdown, merged with --include.

claudeMdLines.description: CLAUDE.md lines. Default 200 (Claude Code memory docs).

skillMdLines.description: SKILL.md lines. Default 500 (Claude Code skills docs).

cursorRuleLines.description: Cursor rule lines. Default 500 (Cursor rules docs).

windsurfChars.description: Windsurf rule characters. Default 12000 (Windsurf memories docs).

memoryIndexLines.description: MEMORY.md lines. Default 200 (Claude Code memory docs).
